blocks.orig: Manyara’s Secret is a cosy boutique hotel with a view over Lake Manyara National Park, that offers beautifully designed villas for two, four, six or eight people each. Couples who value their privacy can stay in a smaller villa with lush beds, outside showers and a private plunge pool, while families can stay in larger villas with multiple ensuite bedrooms with outside showers and larger private pools for the family to share. Feeling more social? Meet other guests by heading to the communal pool near the restaurant, enjoy delicious food, and take your drink to the fire that gets lit in the night. A wonderful place!
blocks.html: Overlooking Lake Manyara National Park, Manyara’s Secret is a snug boutique hotel whose stylish villas sleep two, four, six or eight guests. If you are a couple and value privacy, a smaller villa gives you sumptuous beds, outdoor showers and your own plunge pool. Families can opt for one of the bigger villas, with a number of ensuite bedrooms, outdoor showers and a larger private pool for everyone to enjoy. Feel like company? The shared pool next to the restaurant is the spot to meet fellow guests, have a delicious meal and take your drink over to the fire, which is lit after dark. A wonderful place!
